Row 362 / identity [5179456,0,11,81] has 3,589 patterns, one residual-free type, 4,624 helper constraints, and is LP-infeasible (HiGHS status 2). Replaced positional labelling by explicit identity mapping and reran 4663=[48373761,0,7,11] and 4664=[48373761,0,7,19]. Both are LP-infeasible and their pattern/helper counts match the durable table.

Replayed the complete 32-row source-feasible universe with the preserved standalone matrix reconstruction. Every row returned HiGHS status 2 (LP-infeasible); zero feasible and zero unknown. This confirms that the earlier 19+13 split was entirely solver-completion, not a surviving helper profile.

Proved that distinct physical certificate sources at a shared supplement endpoint are private points of their label B-neighbourhoods, yielding delta_t >= |union C_i|-a and the profile-only corollary delta_t >= rho+r_t-min h_i. Regression checked 15,957 locally assignable subsets on 575 independently certified D2C graphs (921 maximum-degree roots), including both balanced-complete-bipartite parities and X3: zero violations; 779 cases strictly beat the best pairwise bound, by up to 5.

Implemented g(J)=max(0,rho+|J|-min h_i) as a per-right-type deficit floor. It does not improve the five audited leading n=18 profiles (including 555), identifying a real limitation rather than claiming closure. Full n=14,Delta=8 replay closed 150 scalar candidates with no survivors; n=15,Delta=8 has no scalar candidates; explicit n=16,Delta=9 shard 201-400 had no survivors and closest gap +6. The initially attempted n16 prefix process ended after progress through 200 without a FINAL record and is not used for a range-closure claim.

Proved that labels sharing an assigned endpoint have incomparable B-neighbourhoods, and |R_J| is at most min_i sum_{u in P_i(J)}(d(u)-2), hence at most (Delta-2)min_i|P_i(J)|. Regression inspected 2,685,701 label subsets, 6,245 nonempty common-endpoint families, and 6,944 common endpoints on 575 certified D2C graphs: zero violations; exact degree capacity attained 80 times.

Added the missing physical right-vertex budget sum n_{J,z}<=Delta to the strengthened witness model. Five leading n18 minimum deficits remain unchanged, so dense realizability remains open. Explicit n16,Delta9 source-union-v3 shards 401-3200 contain zero survivors; together with the earlier finalized 201-400 shard, range 201-3200 is closed. Range 1-200 is not claimed because its attempt lacked a FINAL record.
